decisions.reason: Location-based margin analysis has its own page, runs on the maintained market-data databases at low marginal cost, and gives utilities analytical value that fits the platform strategy.
Gas tariff comparison is close to the core offer and uses the same daily updated data, and the 2024 withdrawals of C and F show that consolidation tends to keep the core comparison tools.

This calculator line is only mentioned on the website and the related electricity calculator C was already withdrawn, so consolidation risk is real, but D likely absorbed C's role as the multi-energy calculator within the platform.
The area definition tool is an enabling component for the remaining location-based products and fits the integrated platform direction.
